text: Jaguars running back Bhayshul Tuten questionable for Thursday night game. Bhayshul Tuten is trending because his injury status is in doubt before the Jacksonville Jaguars play the Baltimore Ravens on Thursday night in Week 9. The Jaguars listed him as questionable on their final injury report, and he missed practice on Tuesday and Wednesday.. Tuten is a running back for the Jacksonville Jaguars, and he has been one of the team's top offensive options this season. He has been dealing with a foot and ankle injury. The Jaguars face the Baltimore Ravens on Thursday Night Football to open Week 9. Head coach Liam Coen said Tuten would likely be a game-time call. Coen predicted Tuten would take part in practice, but he did not practice on Tuesday or Wednesday. Fantasy football analysts have been weighing whether to start him, and backup Chris Rodriguez Jr. May take on a bigger role if Tuten cannot play. Teammate Travon Walker is also listed as questionable with a rib injury.. The Jaguars and Ravens play on Thursday night, and the coach has said Tuten's status will be a game-time decision.

What is a game-time decision? Meaning in the NFL injury report. What is a game-time decision? It is an injury status meaning a player's availability will not be settled until shortly before kickoff. In the NFL it is used when a team says a player may play or sit depending on how he feels that day, as the Jaguars said about running back Bhayshul Tuten for Thursday's game against the Ravens..
